reports.title: Grocery Outlet Holding Corp. Announces Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: The Company has revised key guidance figures for fiscal 2026 as shown in the current guidance as follows:

Previous | Current
New store openings, net(1) | 30 to 33 | 30 to 31
Net sales | $4.70 to $4.72 billion | $4.70 to $4.72 billion
Comparable store sales increase / decrease | "-0.5% to 0.0%" | 0.2% to 0.4%
Gross margin | 29.8% to 30.0% | 29.8% to 30.0%
Adjusted EBITDA | $225 million to $235 million | $225 million to $229 million
Diluted adjusted earnings per share | $0.51 to $0.55 | $0.52 to $0.55
Capital expenditures (net of tenant improvement allowances) | $170 million | $170 million
